name: Schemas Created by Format
description: 2-minute timeshift delta of avro/json/protobuf schemas created.
programText:
raw_0 = data('kafka_schema_registry_avro_schemas_created_avro_schemas_created', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'schemaregistry') and filter('service.instance.id', 'schemaregistry-0'))
((raw_0 - raw_0.timeshift('2m')) / 120).publish(label='Avro')
raw_1 = data('kafka_schema_registry_json_schemas_created_json_schemas_created', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'schemaregistry') and filter('service.instance.id', 'schemaregistry-0'))
((raw_1 - raw_1.timeshift('2m')) / 120).publish(label='JSON')
raw_2 = data('kafka_schema_registry_protobuf_schemas_created_protobuf_schemas_created', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'schemaregistry') and filter('service.instance.id', 'schemaregistry-0'))
((raw_2 - raw_2.timeshift('2m')) / 120).publish(label='Protobuf')
